nom: Clinique Take The Day Off Facial Cleansing Mousse Cleanser

avis.texte: I received this as a gift and I have to tell you, its just as good as the clinique balm. I recommend it.

I love this stuff! It's silky smooth and cleans well. No scent or residue left. I rub it all over my face and neck. I also keep one in the shower! I received a small one with purchase, which is the awesome thing about Clinique. This allows you to try different products to see if you like them.
I usually don't like creamy cleansers, but I really like this one. It removes makeup well and I feel clean and refreshed. Waiting for it to be back in stock.
I received it as a compliment on Black Friday. It removes great the makeup the skin remains clean but it dries out too much my skin

This is my FAVORITE makeup remover. EVER. A little goes a long way. I was tired of oily removers that you had to double rinse, or deal with residue, and tired of dragging wipes or cotton rounds constantly on my face, being rough with my skin. I needed something gentle and guys. It is so gentle on your skin and removes makeup so well, you only need to rinse or very gently wipe off. The product is smooth and works into a luxurious lather. This is hard to find now in stores. Clinique, please do not discontinue or phase out this product. So many of us love it!

the moment I lathered this product on my skin it was burning, it's been three days since I used it and I have a completely broken skin barrier. hot, red, itchy, flaky. I don't recommend anyone use this product.

avis.titre: Received a tester and fell in love
avis.texte: Great cleanser, would purchase again I thought that it took off my make up and dirt from the day very well and had my face feeling very clean.

this is my first time using any of Clinque's makeup removing products. As soon as I lathered the product, my make up came completely off with no residue or patches of makeup left. I am very pleasantly surprised at the strength as someone who uses alot of makeup on a daily. I will absolutely will be adding this to my everyday routine.

i got this as a free gift with purchase and was excited about using it to cleanse my skin. BUT..... the first time i used it just burned, burrned and is still burning 1/2 hour after washing it off. It has left a red rash across my cheek bones. I stupidly went ahead and put on my Turnaround Cream, and that is causing more burning. I hav e put A&K Emollient all over my face now (it's for)) diaper rash, and the burning is starting to go away. Maybe my skin is too sensitive. I'm searching for a cleanser now that will be very gentle on my face.

I got this product in a bundle with some other products I enjoy. I was hesitant to use it because I am sensitive to a lot of products. This was so good at removing my makeup and left my skin soft and clean. So happy I found this cleanser. Will rotate in my night time skin care routine with another favorite cleanser I use.

avis.titre: Sensitive Skin BEWARE Itchy, red bumps, very dry
avis.texte: This product made my face itch so much it was horrible. Little red bumps, and super dry.
Very nice cleanser, I use it as my second step on removing my makeup and I think it does a great job!

This cleanser treats my sensitive & dry skin with excellent care, effectively removing mineral sunscreen without stripping my skin of its natural moisture. It leaves my face feeling very soft & healthy and ready for the next skincare step. Another thing that I love about this cleanser is that a little goes a long way; it's a great value for the price.

avis.titre: Takes off makeup but I would not purchase again
avis.texte: I was looking for a new facewash that specifically removes makeup. This lathers well, has a nice creamy texture, and a little goes a long way. It effectively removed my makeup, but it left my skin feeling dry/tight and stung my eyes pretty bad.

I've been using Clinique since my 20s, and typically don't wear too much makeup, but I do wear it. Any other cleansers aside from Acne foaming cleanser (I don't have acne, but have tried various products over the last 20 years) has caused a reaction in very sensitive skin I have. This stuff is WONDERFUL! I received this as a sample so tried it. You only need a couple drops on dampened hands, rub your hands briskly and you have a thick mound of foamy bubbles to wash your face with. Absolutely the best cleaner I've ever used!!
This mousse transforms into a rich and silky foam when prepared correctly between the palms before applying to face. Cleanses and hydrates. Great skin prep for evening serums and moisturizers.

avis.titre: Not as good as the balm
avis.texte: I love the take off the day balm and oil, but the mousse didnt take my mascara off as well and stung my eyes like crazy.
The best make up remover I ever used. Other brands were too harsh on my face and barely removed the make up.
I got a sample of this and had no problems on my super sensitive rosacea skin. Loved the smoothness of the foam and it washed off clean. I'll buy a tube.

avis.titre: removed my makeup but my eyes burnedddd
avis.texte: i got the travel size cleansing mousse with a free gift after i bought clinique products and was excited to try it. i read the back and there were no words in the directions saying avoid eyes. i only wear eyeliner and mascara so the eyes were the only place i needed to use it. once i put it on my eyes and rubbed it in, it burned like helllll. after i used it i looked on the back again and there is a little picture of an eye crossed out. but like who makes a makeup remover that cant be used on eyes like what???!!! make it make sense.

I used it and within 30 seconds my face started burning. I rinsed it off as fast as I could, and my face was all red and tingly, even a day later it's irritated and red. I don't know what's in this stuff, but I've never had a reaction like that before and I use Take The Day Off Balm with no problems.

avis.titre: Oh boy did I mess up
avis.texte: Please use caution with this product. I used this to take off my makeup at the end of the day, assuming it was a similar formula to the other 'take the day off' products like their cleansing balm. It was indeed not. My eyes have never burned more. I dont know why they would make a makeup remover you cannot put anywhere near your eyes. To be fair there was a TINY 'avoid contact with eyes' on the back, I read after I burned my eyes. Even so, there is still redness aroumd my eyes and all over my cheeks. I have allergic reactions to a lot of products so I had to take multiple benadryl after this experience and am hoping not to wake up with my eyes completely swollen shut tomorrow.

I always enjoyed the effectiveness of the Take The Day Off balm but I hated the consistency and oily feeling after. The mousse is everything I need. Does an excellent job at removing makeup and doesn't leave me feeling oily after. I would reccomend this to everyone. I feel it could work for all skin types.

Love the formula, hate the smell. I mean, it's not fragranced, but it has a chemical smell to it. That said, its one of the most effective cleaners I've ever used. I use only as an evening cleanser—it literally removes every trace of makeup/dirt/oil. It foams up very nicely, it rinses right off, and it doesn't leave any residue. I use over my eyes, but I don't open them until I've thoroughly rinsed, so I've never had an issue with it burning my eyes. I do prefer the smell of Clinque's liquid soap facial cleanser—actually, I love the non-fragrances smell of that one; wish this could smell just clean rather than "chemically". Take the day off will leave your skin squeaky clean. I don't mind that because I apply serum and moisturizer afterward. When the bottle got to then end, it still felt kind of heavy. I cut the tube and scraped out what was left and transferred to a clean, reusable jar and got about 3 more weeks of cleanser out if it. Will purchase again when I've worked through my stash of other face cleansers I've purchased.

I had high hopes, cause a little went a long way once the product was wet. Didnt have any reaction the first time, then the second is when i felt a burn. I think this may have dried out my skin since its one of two new products i added to my routine (the other being a moisterizer)
This cleanser takes off a full coverage full face of makeup in one shot. It leaves my normal-to-oily skin feeling amazing! I highly recommend this cleanser.
This product is awesome!! So silky smooth as it cleanses your face.

avis.titre: I had a bad reaction to this
avis.texte: I have never once had a bad reaction to a skin care or makeup product before, but immedietly after trying this my face was hot and I started to develop hives, Do not try this product!

avis.titre: My skin had a bad reaction to this product
avis.texte: I tried this product from my grab bag, and my skin was immedietly burning and inflamed after using. I have never once had a bad reaction to a makeup or skin care product i have used before, so if you're gettin this make sure you know about the ingredients, otherwise it lathered well and did good job taking off my makeup.

I got this as a sample a few months ago, while I don't use this face wash on the regular, I do use it on days when I am wearing makeup and it's a decent face wash. I like that it is quite foamy. I normally use it after taking the makeup off with take the day off balm.

I bought a Clinique grab bag from Ulta because i wanted to try the black cherry lipgloss. It came with this product, the "take the day off" mousse, and i absolutely fell in love. I live in a dry colder climate in Denver CO and finding products that dont dry me out is crucial. This stuff works like a charm, a little goes a long way, and youre ready to face the world with a bare face in no time. I couple this with Cliniques eye makeup remover instead of rubbing this stuff in/near my eyes.
A little goes a long way. Does a great job of removing makeup, leaving my skin fresh and clean. Did not have to doubie cleanse. A nice product from Clinique.

After using Clinique's even better clinical foundation for years, I was excited to attempt a new product by them. I was given a sample bottle of Clinique's take the day off cleansing mousse from Ulta for spending above a certain amount of $. I went into washing my face confidently, covering my face and neck. Within minutes, my face and neck broke out in hot itchy red bumps. I immediately washed my face with a different face wash and applied cold compress. After 30-45 minutes of pure itchiness and heat with new spots arising, I had to take one of my partner's Allegras. Though it was soothed, I am still having some itchy spots arise a couple hours later. I have NEVER had an allergic reaction before in my life. I was extremely shocked to say the least. This has been a horrible experience.

I would like to return this product and get replacement products, which is a first in my 25+ years of Clinique patronage. I used this product for only two days and it caused my skin to dry out so badly it was actually uncomfortable. There is a full tube left as it is unusable to me. The feel of it as I lathered it and put it on my face felt good but afterwards, I knew immediately it wasn't for me. I'm not sure it's for any 50+ year old person going through menopause experiencing drier skin. If I could please get my money back or if you could send me the extra-mild and/or mild All About Clean cleansers, I would appreciate it. I find both of those formulas much kinder to my skin if I interchange them during the week.
I got a mini size of this product to take on the go and just love how it lathers and feels on my skin. I'll get a full size eventually.
I got the mousse in a gift. I like the esy it removes makeup, but the stinhing of my skin is not worth it. Im going back to my DHC oil. I wish Clinique would provide an explanation.

avis.titre: All Traces of Makeup Are Gone!
avis.texte: I tried this when it first came out and I returned it because it burned my eyes no matter how careful i was. I repurchased 6 months later because after trying many other products this one was the best at removing all my makeup and leaving my skin soft, not tight dry or itchy. I still am very careful not to get near my eyes but when i did, it didn't burn as much as I remembered. I use the liquid take the day off with a cotton pad for my eye makeup. Now, im always stocked with this stuff.
At 58 years old, I have been battling dry skin. The Clinique sample of this mousse won me over! With just one use, my skin felt supple and soft. I'm loving my skin again!
I bought this cleanser for one of my friends' birthday. She said it is very soft and it doesn't make your skin dry after washing your face.

Clinique's Take The Day Off Cleansing Mousse is a game-changer in my skincare routine. The silky mousse texture is a delight to apply, and it effortlessly melts away makeup, oil, and impurities. I'm particularly impressed with the gentle formula, which includes hyaluronic acid and glycerin to condition the skin, leaving it feeling soft and cushioned. What I love about this product is that it's suitable for all skin types and doesn't strip my skin of its natural oils. Even after multiple washes, my skin feels refreshed and not at all dry. The inclusion of coconut in the ingredients adds a touch of nourishing care, which is a pleasant bonus. **Pros:** Luxurious texture, gentle yet effective cleansing, skin-conditioning ingredients **Cons:** May require multiple applications for thorough cleansing. **Best Uses:** Nighttime skincare routine, makeup removal, daily cleansing, after Take the Day Off balm/oil **Skin Type:** Suitable for all skin types **Tip:** Use a dime-size amount on damp hands and face
I like it. Cleans perfectly, skin is soft and delicate. Excellent care.

avis.titre: I love this, it cleared my skin
avis.texte: I have acne prone skin. I used to double cleanse with take the day off balm and then cliniques acne wash. I switched to using this as the first step of my double cleanse. For me, it is very gentle and soothing and doesn't strip or dry me out. It feels very effective at cleansing. It feels luxurious. My skin feels so soft and clean after using. Sometimes I use this as my only cleanser if I didn't wear makeup. My skin now has not a single breakout which hasn't happened in months. I also started using cliniques do over peel recently which is probably helping with clearing my skin. But I believe this cleanser has been amazing for my skin because it effectively cleanses but is gentle and moisturizing. I'm not sure why it has such bad reviews. I think some people are using it wrong - you have to add water for it to lather. I add it to my hands, then add water and lather in my hands before using it on my skin.

This facewash gives you that squeaky clean feeling. I had a bad reaction to something in it though. It burns my skin every time I use it. For reference the same thing happends to me when I use a product with salicylic acid. I'm throwing this away!

I had high high hopes for this product, I overheard a sales rep at one of the stores mention it to another client as I walked by and I instantly stopped in my tracks and put a bottle in my shopping bag. I have loved the take the day off cleansing balm for many years and have used it faithfully, so naturally I expected a lot from this product. I knew it would be best as the second part of a double cleanse, but when used, my eyes burned. I know it may sound obvious because its soap.. but I've used CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser for years as well and have never had that issue. This product did not work very well for me as a simple face wash either unless I only wore skin tint or nothing at all. For the price point, it would've at least been worth finishing the bottle if it weren't so painful.
This made my skin glow! Removed all my makeup in a single wash, no double wash needed!

I would not use this solely to remove my eye makeup becasue I know it's strong and I'd get it in my eyes, but I use this as my final remover after the pomade breaksdown all my makeup and follow up with this for a squeaky clean feel everytime! Its an addicting feeling once you feel your face so clean from all makeup! The mousse is nice and only need a nickel size.

avis.titre: DO NOT GET IN YOUR EYES
avis.texte: Okay so obviously you're supposed to be careful not to get your face wash in your eyes right? Well duh! That goes with pretty much any product. However, I did just that tonight by accident and let me tell you I literally screamed. It burns SO SO SO bad. I have a pretty high pain tolerance and I've been uncomfortable for 2 hours after. Do not use this face wash to remove your eye make up and be extra cautious not to get it in your eyes. A positive of this product is that it gets every single bit of make up off. Leaves the skin very squeaky clean. But because of this it's not moisturizing at all.
burns my eyes when rinsing it off does remove makeup n feels gd on skin

avis.titre: Wear goggles!Melts your makeup and your eyes too!
avis.texte: This cleanser is terrifying to use! It takes away your face makeup but if this thing gets in your eyes…start praying. Don't recommend there are better cleansers out there that dont blind you.
I use this with the take off the day balm. My face is so clean and feels so good. I use this in the morning as well. It only takes a tiny bit.

Let me preface this by saying I love Clinique products and recommend them to everyone I know. Clinique products have always been great for me. Now, I tried this product which I ordered from Ulta Beauty. I followed the directions and specifically avoided the eye area. It lathered nicely, but within moments it started to burn. I frantically was grabbing my soft cloth to get it off as I didn't think just water would be fast enough to get it off. I had a big red mark on my cheekbone and my skin was burning. I've been trying to sooth it with Redness Relief Cream and Moisture Surge which I'm keeping in the fridge for a cooling affect. When I apply cream, my skin hurts. Please note, I very rarely review products, but this was so bad I felt I needed to share my feedback. I would give 0 stars if I could. The only thing I would recommend with this product is that Ulta Beauty and Clinique stop selling it.

Save your skin and do not buy this! I did not use this around my eyes like the label cautions you to avoid the eye as advised. It burne my skin so bad I keep applying cold lotion to soothe it. Terrible!!!!!!
i absolutely love the luxurious feel of this mousse on my skin !

The consistency of the product is awful, but that is no big deal considering how badly this burns if it gets in your eyes…which is kind of unavoidable when cleansing your face. I would never use a makeup removing product that I can't get near my eyes…what's the point??
This is my new favorite cleanser! It foams up sooo much that you only need the smallest amount. I love how clean my skin feels after using this!
I like Clinique because the entire line of already well-known products is replenished with new innovative items

While its mediocre at best at removing makeup, do NOT get this near your eyes! I thiught it would be fine because ots supposed to be a makeup remover, this burned SO BAD and made my eyes water for almost 20 minutes straight. Its pretty pointless if you have to use a second makeup remover to finish what thia product couldn't do. Stick with the cleansing balm for makeup removal!

This takes off the makeup but do not get it in your eyes. It burns my eyes if it does. I was hoping this would be an all over cleanser for me. Using one for eyes and one for your face is so inconvenient.

I recently purchased this by recommendation from a Clinique specialist who to use an official cleanser to wash my face. At first I thought, "here we go buying more product that should do the same things", but I realized all products that state they take off makeup & cleanses actually never do and i always wake up finding maskara left under my eyes which add to dark circles when I wash my face over 3 times.. I use the "take-it-off" pomade origional and alternate with the new charcoal pomade to aggressively remove my mascara and liner ect., then this cleanser to removed ALL left over- never see a glimps of leftover makeup on my lashes or under my eyes! When I wash my face I feel my skin squeak!. Its that powerful and a nickel size is more than enough and with a little water it lathers like a mouse. Absolutely have to follow-up with a good moisturizer since your skin is thouroughly cleaned and may need extra strength if your face is extremely dry (which drinking water w/ electrolytes can help!) If you need a good cleansure without any leftover residue feel, this is definitely it! I would continue buying this!

Ive used a cleansing balm for months and my skin absolutely loves it. It was just hard to travel with because the packaging is fairly bulky, so I figured I'd give this a shot. I love it! I reach for this over my balm most days and it gives me a super thorough clean! I saw reviews that said it burns eyes which i haven't encountered, BUT this is fairly stripping/drying. I follow with a hydrating cleanser which i would normally do anyways so that doesn't bother me but just wanted to warn!

avis.titre: A phenomenal cleanser AND makeup remover!!!
avis.texte: This cleansing mousse is UNREAL!! You only need the tiniest bit, and it foans up beautifully! It says to avoid eye contact, which almost every cleanser that is recommended. So, follow directions and you will love this hydrating and super cleansing mousse! It absolutely is a mousse! It's airy and thick, it cleanses yet moisturizes, and leaves my skin super soft, and my skin's barrier intact. I absolutely love pairing this with all of my other Clinique products!
This facial wash is great for a wash/make - up removal in a creamy, foamy cleanser. It makes my skin feel fresh.

I have been using Clinique products for years. I used this product and It gave me hives all over my face. I am very disappointed in this product. I am scared to trust Clinique products again. I am also a nurse and it has been very difficult to soothe and treat my face since I have used this product.0/10 I don't recommend.

I switched from the Clinique cleansing oil to this mousse, and I feel like my skin is left cleaner than with the oil. No residue but it doesn't totally remove waterproof mascara. I sometimes use a cleanser after the mousse but most of the time I just use toner afterwards. No irritation or fragrance. Rinses off easily.
I have tried lot of make up removers from Clinique and would say that this one is not my favourite but it is fine, it has good formula and removes make up very well

Unlike some other reviews, the mousse that came out of my tube was silky and soft and foamed up beautifully. I used it for the first time in the shower, but when the foam dripped down my face and trailed across my mouth (as all cleansers will do in the shower), I experienced an intense burning so awful, I could not rinse my face fast enough. My lips are not the problem. They are neither chapped nor cracked. In fact, I use Clinique's Moisture Surge Lip Balm. Afterward, my face felt tight and dry, even after a liberal dose of DDML (I normally use DDMG). The kiss of death for me is that this TTDO product can't be used around the eyes (not that I would given how it felt running over closed lips). I don't see the point of this new arrival to the TTDO line.

avis.titre: Hard NO...it is like putting GLUE on your face !
avis.texte: 100% NO to this product...I wanted to love it but ended up hating it after one squirt ! It comes out of the tube like a thick glue...I tried to warm it in my hands before trying to put it on my face but nope, this stuff stayed tacky, gluey, gloopy mess ! I had to wash, wash, wash with lots of water in the my shower to get this junk off my face. I love Take the Day off Balm and will be sticking with that ~

I have very dry skin plus rosacea. If my cleanser doesn't foam up on some level my face doesn't feel as clean. This product is so gentle yet so sudsy. A small pea sized amount goes a long way. Fantastic.
I received a sample of this cleanser and was really impressed with it. It is gentle on the skin, cleans well, and a little goes a long way.
love love love i got it for my grandma for her birthday she loves it
I have used the balm and oil in this brand and thought I would give the mousse a try as the others work great for me. But, It was aweful and the mousse severely burned my eyes. I do not recommend.

I absolutely love and recommend this product. It hydrates and nourishes your skin while your cleansing it and removing any makeup, impurites,spf, etc.. leaves the skin super nice and smooth! love using after removing my makeup with the take the day off balm. It does remove any excess makeup leftover on the face, but not intended to use on the eyes. Clearly a lot of people are missing what it says on the back when reading the directions "AVOID EYE AREA"!!! Reason why they put this is because it has 10% glycerin. So if glycerin gets in your eyes ofc its going to sting/burn. This is a cleanser to double cleanse your skin and remove any excess impurities left.

I received a sample and I've been using this twice a day for about 2 weeks now and let me tell you a little goes a long way.. Its so thick and creamy it foams like a dream mousse.. It cleaned my face very well the first time. No need for a double cleanse. I am obsessed and will buy this product forever!!

avis.titre: Do not get in your eyes
avis.texte: I love how gentle yet foaming this cleanser is. My only negative is if it gets in your eyes it stings pretty bad. Otherwise it is a great product.

I have always loved the cleansing balm so I was excited to try this new cleanser. Unfortunately, it leaves a residue and it burns your eyes so definitely cannot use on eye make up like you can with the balm.

I absolutely LOVE this cleanser!! I got a deluxe sample and immediately bought the full size. I use micellar water on a cotton pad first, then wash with this. I find cleansing balms to be really labor intensive...I have the Take the Day Off Balm, it's literally still sitting sealed on my bathroom shelf (I always wonder if people who use balms just have an unlimited amount of wash cloths, or what they use to wipe it off LOL). I'm super happy with this product.

avis.titre: Too harsh and stripping for my skin
avis.texte: I received a deluxe sample of the Take the Day Off Facial Cleansing Mousse. This cleanser was way too harsh and stripping for my skin and I have an oily/combo skin type. It foams up nicely and felt nice while washing my face. It did feel like a soft mousse texture. However, when I rinsed it off, my face was totally stripped and tight feeling. I do not enjoy a squeaky clean feeling on my face. I couldnt wait to get out of the shower to put some moisturizer on my face. I didnt use it to remove any makeup. I just used it to wash my face after going to the gym. I did not get it near my eyes, so i dont know if it works to get off eye makeup. Other reviews said it burned their eyes. There are way better face washes and makeup removing cleansers on the market. My favorite one is Purity made simple by Philosophy.

avis.titre: Love this more than any cleanser
avis.texte: Feels like a skincare product as a cleanser and is ultra soft and luxurious on my skin. Needed gentle and moisture filled and skin feels fresh and plump. I'm on my second already

I love this mousse to foam cleanser ! One of the best ones I've tried. It leaves my skin feeling silky smooth and preps skin for my serums and moisturizer. I use it to double cleanse. First removing my make up with the Take the day off balm(especially around the eyes) rinse off then clease with this cleanser with its luxury lather. A little goes a long way ! Love love love ❤️

avis.titre: Not for eye makeup - Burns Your Eyes
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this because I absolutely love the cleansing balm but this does not compare. it takes a long time to wash off, leaves a weird residue and it does not wash mascara off well at all - and it will burn your eyes in the process.

avis.titre: Love the clinique balm, the mousse is awful
avis.texte: Was excited to try a new product from Clinique. Their make up balm is awesome so I figured this would be good. However, if the product gets in your eyes, which it always does, it burns like no other. If dries your skins. It is way too harsh for anyone with even mildly sensitive skin.

This is a bubbly face wash. Definitely removes makeup well and cleans out the pores. If you have trouble with this face wash drying you out, I highly recommend double cleansing and a good moisturizer afterwards. Very satisfied & will repurchase. My pores have never looked so good and skin so clean. New skin care staple 💜😶‍🌫️

I used the take the day off balm for years and thought this would be lighter for my oil prone skin, but I can't use it for my eye makeup because it burns like crazy if it gets near my eyes. Going back to the balm, sadly.
Great cleanser that doesnt strip the skin. I double cleanse no matter what cleanser im using and my skin stil felt great after using the cleansing mousse. Lathers very well

avis.titre: Removes makeup well, but stripped all natural oils
avis.texte: Tried a sample size of this product and did not love it like the Clinique Take the Day Off Cleansing Oil. I felt it stripped the natural oils from my face (I have oily skin), and had to instantly needed to put lotion on, as it felt squeaky. Great concept, but not a great product.

Very satisfied with this cleanser. Doesnt leave my face tight or dry feeling and im a dry skin type. It does clean very well. Im using it along with the take the day off balm. Together they powerful! Ive been using it for two weeks now. Ive used many many face washes its up there with my all time favorite tatcha rice wash.

I received this as a gift for purchasing other clinic products. I absolutely love love that take the day off balm. It is very thick and you do need to add water to make sure that it lathers, however have a towel nearby because it is going to burn the heck out of your eyes when you rinse it off and I do mean burn. Yes, I know it says to avoid the eyes, I had no idea that it was going to have such a harsh effect on my eyes and my skin my skin was burning. My eyes felt like I had acid poured in them. I typically don't use any sort of towel or rag to wipe off cleansing product I normally do use the bomb or cleansing oil and it just rinses off with water, I threw this in the trash I highly highly ask you to caution yourself before you use this product because it will burn your eyes. Even just a little littlest amount gets in your eyes which is hard to do once it's all over your face.
I LOVE Clinique products. All except this one. By day 4 my skin broke out like a teenager, even on my cheeks. And I've never had breakouts as a teenager!
I was hesitant to buy because a lot makeup removers burn my skin and the bottle seemed small for the price. This is great for my sensitive skin. A little goes a long way and it works really well
This is a very nice product. Extremely gentle if you have sensitive skin. It leaves your complexion feeling very soft & pampered.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I got this a gift and it really cleans, a little amount goes a long way. Since it's a mousse it gets creamy and it easily can be spread and rubbed around your face. My face feels super clean and ready for the follow up products in my routine.. it's fragrance free which is great i don't like extra additives for my facial products

As a previous reviewer noted, it really does produce a "squeaky clean!" I used as a double cleanser in my PM routine after using the Take The Day Off balm to remove my makeup. My skin felt incredibly clean with no tightness or dryness. I recieved a sample of this with a recent purchase so i will definitely be going in to get the full size bottle.

I bought this on a whim because it was by the register and it was new. I've tried the cleansing balm and many years ago the cleansing oil but this mousse version surpasses both! I like the texture of this, it's not too thick, it literally is a mousse. After using this wash for a few days I find it doesn't dry my already dry skin out like typical foaming cleansers do, I have had no reaction from my sensitive skin, and I am still loving the texture of this.
